definitions.explanation: The school that is speaking or writing — used by a school about itself in official documents, websites, and announcements.
The principal campus of a school that also operates one or more branch campuses ({分校|ぶんこう}).

examples.japanese: {本校|ほんこう}の{歴史|れきし}。
{本校|ほんこう}では{制服|せいふく}を{着用|ちゃくよう}します。
examples.english: At our school, uniforms are worn.

examples.japanese: {本校|ほんこう}は{地域|ちいき}の{方々|かたがた}に{支|ささ}えられて{百年|ひゃくねん}を{迎|むか}えました。
examples.english: Supported by the local community, our school has reached its hundredth year.

examples.japanese: {本校|ほんこう}は{駅|えき}の{近|ちか}くにある。
examples.english: The main campus is near the station.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}から{分校|ぶんこう}の{生徒|せいと}も{本校|ほんこう}に{通|かよ}う。
examples.english: From next year, the branch-campus students will attend the main campus too.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{上|うえ}の{分校|ぶんこう}が{閉|と}じられ、{子|こ}どもたちは{毎日|まいにち}バスで{本校|ほんこう}まで{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: The branch school up in the mountains was closed, and the children now commute to the main campus by bus every day.

notes:
Composed of {本|ほん} (main, this) + {校|こう} (school). Which sense applies depends on who is speaking: a school describing itself means sense 1; a contrast with {分校|ぶんこう} means sense 2.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {本校|ほんこう}の{生徒|せいと}: students of this school
- {本校|ほんこう}{独自|どくじ}の{取|と}り{組|く}み: this school's own initiative
- {本校|ほんこう}と{分校|ぶんこう}: the main campus and the branch campus
- {本校|ほんこう}に{通|かよ}う: to attend the main campus

REGISTER:
Sense 1 belongs to formal institutional writing — school websites, printed notices, principals' greetings. A student talking about their own school would say {うちの学校|うちのがっこう} instead.
